bibl.title: Tārāvalīstotra
bibl.note: Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.

The legend has it that it was composed in relation to his bringing back to life a brahmin (or child) who had died of a cobra bite. The second verse of each verse has a direct reference to this event. See Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952: p. 63.
